name: Henry I
note: County of Northern Nassau, co-ruler with his brothers Emicho I and John until 1303 (source: from 1289/90); from 1303 Count of Siegen, which after 1328 held Dillenburg; work list has Otto I; source: Otto I died between 3 May 1289 and 19 March 1290

name: Emicho I
note: co-ruler of Northern Nassau with Henry I and John (source: 1289/90-1303); then Count of Hadamar

name: John
note: co-ruler of Northern Nassau 1289/90-1303, then Count of Dillenburg 1303-1328; after his childless death Nassau-Dillenburg fell to Nassau-Siegen (Siegen and Dillenburg united until 1606)

name: Otto II
note: Count of Siegen; inherited Siegen and Dillenburg; source: July/August 1343 - December 1350 or January 1351

name: John I
note: Count of Siegen; source: from December 1350 or January 1351; regency of his mother Adelaide of Vianden 1351-1362

name: Adolph I
note: co-ruler with his brothers John II, Engelbert I and John III (tetrarchs)

name: John II with the Helmet
note: co-ruler with his brothers

name: Engelbert I
note: co-ruler with his brothers

name: John III the Younger
note: co-ruler with his brothers

name: John IV

name: Henry II
note: co-ruler with John IV until 1447, then kept Dillenburg

name: Margaret
note: listed in source as ruling in the County of Siegen

name: John IV
note: second tenure; reunited the possessions after Henry II's death

name: William Louis
